scope: One common separately compiled C timing/observation driver; dynamically loaded variants; no cross-library LTO. Generated C and Rust -O3/native CPU. Resident and full input-snapshot modes separate; allocation/free for generated intermediates and outputs plus final consumption/arena-reset are timed. Expert Rust can reuse output destination. Calibration starts at one call and grows to at least1ms, bounded at5million calls; integer-difference mach_absolute_time on macOS avoids microsecond CLOCK_MONOTONIC quantization. Only the active Ink task arena is reset. Both implementations cross one shared-library call boundary; Rust ABI adapter compiles in the same unit; native scalar results return directly through the shared bench_scalar helper without Wasm output stores, vector scratch unchanged. Input generation/loading and dynamic module startup excluded. Different LLVM versions and shared-machine limits recorded.
